hypotheses_validated.claim: quant.c survivors (82), all equivalent or only observable with ASan / leak tooling. Boundary-equivalent (both sides give the same result at the boundary): M0081,M0295,M0319,M0387,M0939 (n<=0 -> n<0: n==0 yields the same empty result), M0124,M0416 (amax update on >=), M0132,M0137,M0155,M0160,M0428,M0429 (clamps at exactly -127/127/-8/7), M0703 (t<=rem?t:rem is still min(t,rem)), M0822 (T == SIZE_MAX/ab: a SIZE_MAX-byte allocation fails either way), M0956,M0962 (softmax max loop from 0 / on >=). Equivalent by construction: M0061,M0066 (f16 saturation masks: inf has an even mantissa, bit 0 of 0x7bff already set, NaN scales never reach it with odd mantissa), M0217 (sizeof q4_div[1]), M0245,M0248 (duplicate-scale skip only saves work; a duplicate scores equal and ties keep the earlier), M0263 (best_sqq==0 means every scale quantizes to 0; refit cannot lower the error), M0289 ((q-8)<<4 == (q+8)<<4 mod 256), M0558 (return 2 is truthy), M0577 (invalid ISA reaches hx_kernels_for's default: NULL anyway), M0589 (loop still stops at the first mismatch or at both NULs), M0593 ('Z' occurs in no keyword), M0852,M0853,M0896,M0897 (16-chunk loop vs tail loop compute the same lane assignment). Equivalent by measurement (independent Python reference of the documented algorithm, 1024 heavy-tailed + 192 pinned blocks): M0151,M0152,M0153 (divisors -10.5/-11/-12 sign-flipped: 0 blocks change), M0234 (sx2 sign flipped = constant shift of every candidate error: 0 blocks change), M0269 (accept an equal-error refit: 0 exact ties occur). Thread-count only (output is thread-count independent by design; checked with 1/2/3/5/7/auto/1000 threads incl. a 300x57344 matrix): M0663-M0672, M0675, M0678, M0679-M0685, M0688-M0694, M0710 (a row quantized twice, same bytes), M0713, M0716, M0722 (jobs run inline via the fallback). Leak / unjoined thread (same bytes; not observable without leak tooling, MSVC ASan has no leak checker): M0717, M0718, M0719, M0727 (a created thread is treated as failed: its job is rerun inline and the thread is never joined; can race with a later free of dst), M0845 (activation buffer leaked). Out-of-bounds by one, killed by the ASan run: M0037,M0040,M0046,M0057 (memcpy 5 bytes), M0275 (q[64]), M0460,M0885,M0932 (tree loop j<=s reads L[16]; L[0] is still correct), M0904,M0907 (dot16 chunk writes L[16]).

hypotheses_validated.claim: hearth_matmul no longer risks a size_t wrap of the activation buffer (INV-SAFE hardening): n_cols up to 2^40 and T up to INT_MAX are individually valid, and ab*T could wrap (to exactly 0 for Q4/Q8, n_cols=2^40, T=2^30), giving a tiny allocation and a heap overflow. It now returns -3 when T > SIZE_MAX/ab.
hypotheses_validated.evidence: test_sizes: hearth_matmul(Q8, 2^40 cols, T=INT32_MAX) and (Q4, 2^40 cols, T=2^30) both return -3 without allocating or reading X. Mutants that weaken the guard (M0824 SIZE_MAX/ab -> SIZE_MAX*ab) are killed.

hypotheses_falsified.claim: tests/py/test_convert.py::test_q4_conversion_close_to_f32[deepseek_v3] (owned by T03) fails because of T02's Q4 quantizer.
hypotheses_falsified.evidence: It fails with rel RMS logit error 0.1603 vs its 0.15 threshold. A scratch DLL whose Q4 quantizer is reduced to plain absmax/7 (no search, no refit) also fails: 0.1505. qwen3_moe passes with both (0.0862 with the search, 0.1026 with absmax/7). gen-2 did not change the quantizer: both gen-1 pinned hashes are unchanged. The threshold is marginal for this tiny routed model, where routing flips dominate the end-to-end error.
